My Morning Jacket at Bank of America Pavilion

with Neko Case, Adela & Jude

  • Aug 13, 2011
  • Boston, Massachusetts

My Morning Jacket touring Circuital. I don’t consider myself a super-fan, compared to the dead-level fandom they’ve created, but this album is my favorite. Was a treat to see it performed live.

Neko Case

Rich, wise, noir-country appetizer for MMJ. I knew her for her Fox Concessor… singles and had Middle Cyclone on CD. She filled that rubbery stadium.
